findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cordon_read, cordon_scan · Private data: cordon_scan · Public sink: cordon_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cordon_read, cordon_scan · Private data: cordon_scan · Public sink: cordon_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
